title: Home Comfort Financing Desk Memo: Promotional-Financing Fee on Line-Set Change Orders
content:
# Promotional-financing fee on a line-set change order

## Terms

The promotional-financing fee on a line-set change order of a Replacement System Installations project follows the Home Comfort Financing account linked to the project:

- an account in approved or active status on the 12-Month Same-As-Cash Deferred Interest Plan adds 6 percent;
- an account in approved or active status on the 18-Month 0% APR Equal Payment Plan or the 36-Month 0% APR Equal Payment Plan adds 4 percent;
- a project with no account in approved or active status on one of those three plans adds no promotional-financing fee.

## Plan and status grid

| Linked financing account plan | Approved or active | Any other status |
|---|---|---|
| 12-Month Same-As-Cash Deferred Interest Plan | 6 percent | No fee |
| 18-Month 0% APR Equal Payment Plan | 4 percent | No fee |
| 36-Month 0% APR Equal Payment Plan | 4 percent | No fee |
| 60-Month 5.99% APR Fixed-Rate Plan | No fee | No fee |
| 120-Month 7.99% APR Fixed-Rate Plan | No fee | No fee |
| 144-Month 9.99% APR Fixed-Rate Plan | No fee | No fee |
| No linked account | No fee | No fee |

## Points of judgement (hypothetical projects)

- A project linked to an approved account on the 36-Month 0% APR Equal Payment Plan: 4 percent.
- A project linked to an active account on the 12-Month Same-As-Cash Deferred Interest Plan: 6 percent.
- A project linked to a declined account on the 12-Month Same-As-Cash Deferred Interest Plan: no fee, because the account is neither approved nor active.
- A project linked to an approved account on the 60-Month 5.99% APR Fixed-Rate Plan: no fee.
